svg.title: SMART-QSO deployed configuration
svg.text: VIEW D from -Z (AntS face): wings and antenna elements deployed
2 m element 500 (along +X; length per ISIS tuning)
+Y (sun, spin axis) is down in this view
wings in the plane y = 37.1 to 39.4, front cells toward +Y
VIEW E from +Y (sun side): front faces of the deployed wings (antenna elements omitted)
SMART-QSO 1U | SQSO-MECH-CAD-001 Sheet 2: deployed configuration | dimensions mm
Wings rotate 90 deg about the hinge axes (x, y) = (+-54.1, 38.75) mm, parallel to Z, into the plane y = 37.1 to 39.4 mm; front cells face +Y.
AntS option A (BASELINE 7): one 2 m tape element along +X, one 70 cm element along -X, in the plane z = -52.0 mm (centre of the housing); root and sweep per the ISIS ICD (open).
Deployed inertia about the CG, CBE: Ixx 2.772, Iyy 3.956, Izz 3.744 x 1e-3 kg m2; Iyy/max(Ixx, Izz) 1.057 (MEV 1.047); major axis 0.3 deg (MEV 1.3 deg) from +Y. Requirement: >= 1.03 and <= 5 deg.
